detectors.name: Encrypted Malware
detectors.headline: AUC 0.99–1.00 on 4 of 5 unseen malware families
detectors.detail: 90% recall at 0.1% false alarms on 2025 Lumma Stealer (TLS 1.3), a family never seen in training.
detectors.method: Leave-one-family-out on real Stratosphere CTU + 2025 in-the-wild captures · 27,349 real TLS sessions · JA4 + packet shape/timing, never decrypted

detectors.name: Port Scanning
detectors.headline: ~84% recall · 0 false positives
detectors.detail: Slow scans detected up to 45 s between probes · ~73,000 flows/s per core.
detectors.method: Source-disjoint replay: a separately captured batch from attacker IPs never seen in training

detectors.name: Data Exfiltration
detectors.headline: 13/13 held-out attacks caught
detectors.detail: 25/27 real exfiltration-shaped flows in public CIC-IDS2018 · 5–14 ms per flow.
detectors.method: Independently generated held-out batch with different sizes/timing, plus unmodified model on CIC-IDS2018

detectors.name: DGA / DNS Tunnelling
detectors.headline: 72% mean recall on 136 unseen DGA families
detectors.detail: Median 88% · 77 of 136 families above 80% recall (random-split recall: 88%).
detectors.method: Leave-one-family-out on DGArchive + Tranco top-1M · 894,756 real domains

detectors.name: Volumetric DDoS
detectors.headline: SYN flood flagged within 1 second
detectors.detail: Three branches: SYN flood · UDP reflection/amplification · spoofed-source flood.
detectors.method: Docker attacker / victim / passive-monitor lab · CUSUM change-point detection
